title: Black Light FTL Tidal Tensor and Eigenbasis Uncertainty Propagation Registry

designIntentSource.title: The different lightspeed methods
designIntentSource.scope: Quantify how astrometric/source-state uncertainty limits confidence in tidal strength, principal eigenvalues, eigendirections, exact coalescence, and the downstream operational normalized near-degeneracy boundary without turning ordinary gravitational uncertainty into fictional FTL hazard canon.

mathematics.tensorCovariance: Sigma_T = sum_a J_a Sigma_r,a J_a^T, where J_a = partial vec_s(T)/partial r_a
mathematics.eigenvalueSensitivity: delta lambda_k = e_k^T delta T e_k
mathematics.eigenvectorPerturbation: delta e_k = sum_{j!=k} e_j (e_j^T delta T e_k)/(lambda_k-lambda_j)
mathematics.orientationVariance: sigma_psi,k^2 ~= sum_{j!=k} Var(e_j^T delta T e_k)/(lambda_k-lambda_j)^2
mathematics.boundaryLocation: sigma_s ~= sigma_g/|dg/ds| under a local first-order exact-coalescence crossing model
mathematics.normalizedDegeneracyVariance: sigma_gamma^2=(grad gamma)^T Sigma_T (grad gamma), with numerator and active normalization scale propagated jointly
mathematics.operationalBoundary: gamma_ij=gamma_min is the eigenbranch identity-loss/restoration boundary used by the adaptive tracker; it is distinct from exact lambda_i=lambda_j coalescence

physicalAssumptions: The implemented tensor-uncertainty model is weak-field and uses the same point-mass tidal tensor already accepted by the physical environment authority.

Source-position covariance is propagated; mass uncertainty, field-point uncertainty, source cross-covariance, and higher-order dynamical covariance require explicit future or caller-supplied authority and are not silently assumed zero if known to matter.

Linear covariance propagation is a local approximation. Large uncertainty, highly nonlinear close approaches, strong-field conditions, or eigenvalue near-degeneracy can invalidate first-order orientation uncertainty.
Eigenvector orientation is an axis quantity with sign gauge e equivalent to -e. Near a degenerate eigenspace, individual-axis orientation is not physically identifiable.

The downstream normalized-degeneracy authority is piecewise differentiable because it contains absolute values and a max normalization; exact gap cusps and active-scale ties must be reported rather than hidden by arbitrary derivatives.

familyUse.gravitic-plane: PRIMARY: distinguishes a resolved rotating tidal geometry and operational branch-identity boundary from an astrometrically uncertain one before fictional shear-fork response is evaluated.
familyUse.slipstream-shear: PRIMARY: supplies uncertainty envelopes for shear-topology precursors and the normalized identity boundary without defining the exotic shear state itself.
familyUse.metric-envelope: SECONDARY: field-distortion and structural orientation uncertainty.
familyUse.n-manifold: SECONDARY: physical-environment uncertainty remains distinct from manifold topology.
familyUse.inertial-torch: STRUCTURAL/NAVIGATION: tidal-load orientation uncertainty and route-state confidence.

generatorRules: Consume propagated source-state covariance from encounter samples; do not synthesize missing covariance as a zero matrix.
Use the tracked eigensystem rather than raw independently sorted eigenvectors when assigning branch uncertainty.
Do not report a linearized individual-axis orientation uncertainty through a degenerate eigenspace.
If orientation uncertainty exceeds the configured linear-model limit, report OUTSIDE_LINEAR_MODEL rather than clipping it to an attractive finite confidence value.
Boundary-location uncertainty is numerical/physical evidence for route refinement and certification. It is not itself a fictional FTL danger probability.

Known joint/correlated source covariance must be represented by a future joint-source authority or explicit caller model; independent per-source covariance packets do not prove statistical independence.
Exact eigenvalue coalescence and the versioned gamma_min operational boundary are separate evidence products; use the downstream normalized-degeneracy authority for the latter.
canonSafeguards: This registry does not establish physical realizability of any FTL family.
Ordinary gravitational covariance cannot create, prove, or silently zero an exotic family-boundary hazard.
A narrow uncertainty envelope around a tidal rotation or normalized degeneracy boundary does not prove that a fictional shear lane or fork exists there.
A broad uncertainty envelope is unresolved knowledge, not automatically high danger.
A selected simulation family does not establish that a named race, civilization, manufacturer, vessel, or archaeological installation uses that family.
Near-degenerate eigenspaces do not possess canonical individual eigenvector directions; machinery or UI layers may not promote a solver-selected basis inside that subspace into setting fact.
DERIVED finite-difference controls, gamma_min, and confidence limits are engineering choices, not constants of nature.
